style: Refine every catalog object toward warm, softly lit cartoon art, consistent with the selected plant reference. Preserve identity, function and original palette family. Keep registered camera, dimensions, roots, sockets, ports, footprints and animation timing. No preferred horizontal light direction for rotatable world sprites; no directional ground shadows. Real 3D render output, editable Blender sources. The source 2D effects remain explicitly identified as 2D. Each object receives fresh independent editor/judge agents. Publish object-by-object to the same PR preview; integrate approved sprites into Godot after catalog review checks. Follow-on design exploration: improve the modeling itself, including forms, proportions, structure, crafted details and decorations. Original part counts and awkward geometry are not constraints. The editor may rebuild native geometry to achieve the better design; the judge should reward useful improvements. Preserve the locked registration, gameplay contact/clearance, animation and modular continuity contract. See modeling-policy.json version2.

priorityOutcomes.outcome: Saturated blue/cyan stone, teal and purple coral retain palette family, with soft broad highlight-to-midtone transitions and readable material separation. Dark recesses are local purposeful depth; no broad black base band, muddy merged group or clipped white sparkle. Equal cardinal softness preserves rotatable-world neutrality.

The W/E interfaces carry one uninterrupted reef surface across repeated middle modules in all four facings. No exposed end face, alpha crack, dark/light stripe or crown step; strict native profile/normal/material evidence and real consumer previews establish this, without hidden overlap or image repair.

Selected larger coral openings, branches/cluster rhythm and crafted stone features enrich the reef while keeping primary silhouettes legible. Do not reward tiny noisy dots, uniform ornament coverage or target details that exceed clearance/port constraints.

Every required facing has coherent volume, generous readable separation and no dead side. No intersections/coplanar flashes, clipped crowns, artificial silhouette rim/glow, directional ground shadow or hidden camera-facing art.
